newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies six issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies six issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co. said it qualified six municipal bond issues for insurance slated for competitive sale on Tuesday.
--Otego-Unadilla CSD, N.Y., $5.4 million of school bonds.
--Washington, N.C., $2 million of General Obligations sewer bonds.
--New York City $200 million of GO bonds.
--Frisco, Texas, $2.5 million of taxable tax and revenue certificates.
--Frisco, Texas, $5.9 million of tax and revenue certificates.
--Frisco, Texas, $4.9 million of GO bonds. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
